newsitem.title: USA: D&P cuts Reliance Acceptance ratings.
newsitem.headline: D&P cuts Reliance Acceptance ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it lowered its rating on several classes of Reliance Acceptance Group Inc's Reliance Acceptance Corp unit's debt.

The auto lender's commercial paper was lowered to D-four from D-two, its subordinated debt was lowered to double-B from double-B-plus and its implied senior unsecured debt rating was lowered to double-B-plus from triple-B-minus.
The ratings affect about $15.8 million in commercial paper and $25 million in subordinated debt outstanding Monday, the rating agency said.

The downgrade reflects Reliance's deteriorating asset quality, declining reserve adequacy and the continued difficult competitive environment in subprime auto lending, Duff & Phelps said in a ratings note.
Increased repossession frequency and lower recovery rates led to the decline in asset quality performance, Duff & Phelps said.
Management has made a change in how it sells repossessed autos and is confident that future recovery rates will improve, Duff & Phelps said.
